en: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Zakariya al-Razi
tr: Ebû Bekr Muhammed b. Zekeriyyâ er-Râzî
ar: أبو بكر محمد بن زكريا الرازي

description.tr: Çiçek hastalığını kızamıktan ilk klinik olarak ayıran, deneysel tıbbın öncüsü ve dogmatik otoriteye karşı akılcı sorgulamanın savunucusu || Râzî, metinsel otoriteye karşı klinik gözlemi savundu — klinik deneylere benzer bir şey yapan (gruplar üzerinde tedavileri test edip sonuçları karşılaştıran) bilinen ilk hekimdir. Galen'in hılt teorisine şüpheciliği çağının yüzyıllar ilerisindeydi. || [Tarih notu] Iskandar'ın 1962 çalışması, Râzî'nin felsefi eserlerini inceleyerek önceki Batı akademisinde tasvir edilen salt tıbbi figürden çok daha radikal bir düşünürü ortaya çıkardı.
description.en: First to clinically distinguish smallpox from measles, pioneer of experimental medicine, and defender of rational inquiry against dogmatic authority || Al-Razi championed clinical observation over textual authority — he is the first physician known to have conducted something resembling clinical trials (testing treatments on groups and comparing outcomes). His skepticism of Galen's humoral theory was centuries ahead of its time. The Hawi was translated into Latin as Continens in 1279 and became one of the most expensive books in medieval Europe. || [Historiographical note] Iskandar's 1962 study on Razi's philosophical works revealed a far more radical thinker than the purely medical figure portrayed in earlier Western scholarship. His theological skepticism, largely suppressed in Islamic biographical tradition, makes him one of the most controversial figures in Islamic intellectual history.
description.ar: أول من ميّز سريريًا بين الجدري والحصبة، ورائد الطب التجريبي || ناصر الرازي الملاحظة السريرية على سلطة النصوص — أول طبيب معروف أجرى ما يشبه التجارب السريرية. شكّه في نظرية الأخلاط لجالينوس سبق عصره بقرون
